results.title: Blood Haven
results.overview: Blood Haven is the first feature film about the scam targeting Vietnamese people seeking overseas employment. Believing promises of "easy work and high pay," many young people are taken to these "special zones," where they are held captive and forced to make phone calls to scam their own compatriots. Many of them manage to escape the hell they have fallen into.

results.title: Hiram
results.overview: Grace and Ivy are half-sisters who finally reunite in New Zealand. But as they begin to share this new life together, that may also include sharing one man.

results.title: Sleepers
results.overview: Anya, a child sleeper agent in America waits for activation. But she learns the American way of life of fun, friendship, and freedom and is faced with the choice: Continue as a sleeper waiting for activation, or live as an American.

results.title: Absolution
results.overview: A Vietnam veteran's chance encounter with a brutal street gang sends him down a path of vengeance.

results.title: Sarah Squirm: Live + in the Flesh
results.original_title: Sarah Squirm: Live + in the Flesh
results.overview: After four seasons (and counting) on Saturday Night Live, Sarah Sherman's unholy alter ego, Sarah Squirm, slithers onto your screen and rips off the straitjacket, unleashing a festering and hilarious hour of bodily fluids, open-wound confessionals, and jokes that will leave scars on your soul.

results.title: Sariwa
results.overview: A lonely, middle- aged man still grieving his past welcomes a young woman into his home -- only to fall into a web of seduction, lies and betrayal when her real motives and those of her best friends are slowly revealed.

results.title: Tazas
results.overview: After forty years, Julián returns to the bar he used to go to with his girlfriend Carmen when he was doing his military service in the city. His intention is to heal an old wound, but he discovers something that will change his life.

results.title: Premistunnaa
results.overview: A boy struggles to express his love to a girl he loves deeply, but she fails to understand his mental state. The burning flame in a loving heart seeks solitude and comfort, making it difficult to express emotions through words.

results.title: The Night of Paris – Terror at the Stade de France
results.original_title: Die Nacht von Paris - Terror am Stade de France
results.overview: On 13 November 2015, Paris is rocked by terrorist attacks. The football stadium where the German national team is playing is also affected. Documentary featuring Oliver Bierhoff and others.

results.title: Sweet Molly
results.overview: At 16, Molly, born and raised in the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints (FLDS) cult, makes a chilling discovery through her ability to astral project, leading to a life-altering event.

results.title: Dollar Babys
results.overview: Stuck for cash, a queer couple venture into the 'Girls Club' of online sex work.

results.title: Gurmukh
results.overview: Gurmukh-the eye witness is story of a common man who strongly believes in his faith Sikhism but one day when he is faced with a tough situation he behaves like a coward. Will he be able to win this internal and external fight?

results.title: Little Siberia
results.overview: A pastor's faith turns upside down when a meteorite lands in his small Finnish town, its impact stirring up chaos and criminal intentions.

results.title: Sex on Phone
results.overview: Amanda, compelled to make ends meet, gets employed in a confidential call center where she fulfills the desires of her callers. When her husband finds out about her odd job, things become chaotic.

results.title: MAX
results.overview: Max, 10 years old, moves into a run-down building with his father – but something feels off. Strange noises, disturbed neighbors, a locked room upstairs… Little by little, Max uncovers a terrifying secret hidden within the walls.

results.title: Ultraman Arc the Movie: The Clash of Light and Evil
results.original_title: ウルトラマンアークTHE MOVIE 超次元大決戦！光と闇のアーク
results.overview: A mysterious space sage entrusts Yuma with challenges that surpass the limits of his imagination with a stake too high. He asks, "Should you fail… then you… will lose your power as Arc." The burden of protecting Hoshimoto City alongside SKIP members are twisted by Sascal, who manipulates them, sending challenge after challenge toward Yuma.  Battling giant kaiju, an evil alien bent on destruction, and a warped dimension where even time itself is distorted, Yuma must confront the ultimate test. Will he... will Ultraman Arc overcome the greatest challenge yet and protect the future, surpassing the limits of the power of imagination?

results.title: Pagdaong
results.overview: The story follows Luna, a writer who is constantly questioned by a curious student named Jane about the meanings behind her poems. As Luna and Jane get to know each other, Jane gradually discovers that Luna’s poems are written for a woman named Ella.

results.title: Armed Only with a Camera: The Life and Death of Brent Renaud
results.original_title: Armed Only with a Camera: The Life and Death of Brent Renaud
results.overview: On March 13, 2022, filmmaker Brent Renaud was killed by Russian soldiers, the first American journalist to die while reporting on the war in Ukraine. His younger brother and collaborator, Craig Renaud, recovered Brent’s body and his final recordings from Ukraine and brought them back to their childhood home in Arkansas. As Brent’s journey to his final resting place unfolds, the film chronicles the years he and his brother spent covering some of the world’s most dangerous conflicts.

results.title: A Gilded Game
results.overview: A gifted but underprivileged finance student, Gao Han, lands a rare internship at a top international investment bank, Bluestone, while helping his friend's family business prepare for a public listing. Surrounded by elite peers with powerful connections, Gao Han stands out for his integrity and raw talent. With the support of a seasoned mentor, he quickly adapts to the high-stakes world of investment banking, but soon discovers that success in this industry comes with hidden costs and fierce competition.

results.title: The Balloon
results.overview: A downtrodden mechanic lives in a deteriorating paradigm, but there is more than meets the eye when the past and present converge.
